description: Source code for disk cache backend implementation, including classes for file enumeration, file operations, and cache backend creation, specific to the Chromium project.

classes.name: TrivialFileEnumerator
classes.description: Implements a simple file enumerator that wraps disk_cache::SimpleFileEnumerator.

classes.name: UnboundTrivialFileOperations
classes.description: Provides a method to bind to create TrivialFileOperations.

classes.name: TrivialFileOperations
classes.description: Implements file operations such as create, delete, replace, and enumerate files, used for disk cache file management.

methods.name: CreateCacheBackend
methods.description: Creates a cache backend, supporting memory cache and error handling.

methods.name: FlushCacheThreadForTesting
methods.description: Flushes thread pools used by cache backends for testing purposes.
